Then nothing changes and the user sees MSG-P7-003

  Scenario: AC3 Party absent or outside the caller's scope (X1)
    Given the party is absent or outside the caller's scope
    When the user reads or changes the contact points
    Then the answer is 404, nothing is read and nothing changes

  Scenario: AC4 Documents right lacking (X2)
    Given the caller's role lacks the Documents right
    When the user reads or changes the contact points
    Then the answer is 403, nothing is read and nothing changes
    Then the user sees MSG-P4-002

  Scenario: AC5 Stale version (X5)
    Given the If-Match version is stale
    When the user changes a contact point
    Then the answer is 409, nothing is sent to the owner and no record is written

  Scenario: AC6 Consent state or channel code not in reference data (X8)
    Given a consent state or a channel code is not in the reference data in force
    When the user changes a contact point
    Then the answer is 422 and the owner is not called
    Then the user sees MSG-GEN-001

  Scenario: AC7 Repeated change with the same version (X9)
    Given a change with an If-Match version has been answered
    When the change is repeated with the same If-Match version
    Then the first answer is returned with status 200 and no second change is recorded

edits.old: Then the first answer is returned with status 200 and no second change is recorded
edits.new:
Then the first answer is returned with status 200 and no second change is recorded

  Scenario: AC8 Owner times out or fails (X6; BR2)
    Given the consent and verification write of the owner times out or answers 5xx
    When the user changes a contact point
    Then nothing changes, the attempt stays in the local chain and the answer is 503

  Scenario: AC9 Contact stop in force (BR5)
    Given a contact stop is in force for the case
    When the user reads the contact points
    Then the read answer carries the stop mark

  Scenario: AC10 Rule values read as data (BR6)
    Given the verification rule or the failed-count threshold changes in the reference data
    When the user reads the contact points
    Then the new value applies with no change to the code

  Scenario: AC11 Consent change keeps the contact value (BR7)
    Given a consent change is accepted for a channel
    When the change is recorded
    Then no contact point is deleted and no contact value changes

  Scenario: AC12 New verified contact point (BR8)
    Given the owner writes a new verified contact point
    When the user reads the contact points
    Then the verified state is visible and this service clears no deviation

  Scenario: AC13 Contact stop does not change consent (BR9)
    Given a contact stop is applied
    When the stop takes effect
    Then the channel leaves the contact plan and no consent record is removed or added

  Scenario: AC14 Identifier, code and date only (BR10)
    Given a contact point is read or a consent change is recorded
    When the element is logged, published or written
    Then it carries an identifier, a code and a date only, and no contact value, masked contact value, name or identity number
